name: Memorial Day
overview: Scripture calls believers to remember significant moments of deliverance and God's faithfulness, as Moses instructed Israel to recall their freedom from Egypt (Exodus 13:3) and Joshua was directed to mark the crossing into the Promised Land (Joshua 4:1). The Bible honors the memory of the righteous, declaring their remembrance as blessed (Proverbs 10:7), and acknowledges the preciousness of the saints' deaths before the Lord (Psalms 116:15). In times of sorrow, God is near to the brokenhearted and calls His people to uphold justice for the vulnerable (Psalms 34:18; 82:3). Memorial Day, therefore, can be understood as a solemn recognition of God's providence, the sacrifice of the faithful, and the call to compassionate remembrance rooted in His Word.
